description: This file is a shell script responsible for configuring and managing a network tunnel protocol using WireGuard. It includes initialization functions, setup, and teardown procedures, and interacts with system and network management tools such as ip tool and ubus.

methods.name: proto_unet_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration schema for the unet protocol, defining parameters such as device, type, auth_key, key, file, keepalive, domain, dht, tunnels, local_network, connect, and peer_data.

methods.name: proto_unet_setup
methods.description: Sets up the WireGuard tunnel based on the provided configuration, creating network interfaces, configuring parameters, and registering the network with the system.

methods.name: proto_unet_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the specified WireGuard tunnel interface and removes its configuration from the system.
